set.body:
Purpose:
Finish the hardening work through downstream integration, documentation, and repository-level proof.

Scope:
- Integrate checked BIDS reports into fmri-workflow catalog compilation without losing path/code/severity information.
- Update motion and other JVM consumers to use the intended strict or diagnostic-preserving loader entry point.
- Preserve exact BIDS-to-result identity and deterministic catalog behavior.
- Add compatibility tests comparing synchronous and kept effectful loader results.
- Add law/invariant tests only for admitted algebraic structures, such as metadata overlay associativity/identity if a Monoid/Semigroup instance is actually introduced.
- Update BIDS README, module relations, and migration examples with the final kept architecture and rejected alternatives.
- Run focused and aggregate verification from a clean or otherwise controlled checkout.

Acceptance:
- bidsJVM/test and bidsJS/test pass.
- Affected motion JVM and fmri-workflow JVM/Scala.js suites pass.
- compileAll and testAll pass warning-clean.
- A realistic multi-defect fixture proves deterministic accumulated diagnostics; a valid fixture proves legacy-result parity.
- The epic records final Cats Core/Cats Effect keep/reject decisions and no unresolved compatibility gaps.
set.title: BIDS F6: integrate diagnostics and pass the cross-platform release gate
